scope: TrafficCap prediction, FromLeft and TrafficRays classification; called curvature helpers remain separately scoped
rangesReviewed: 1021-1170 traffic constants, relative course, time windows and fixed discovery
1187-1343 left-side classification and forward/reverse traffic rays

findings.source: TrafficCap uses six-second closest-approach/time-window tests but discovers vehicles within a fixed 60m query.
findings.wait: FollowingCap previously searched only own travel plus hull margin. The new envelope includes own six-second travel plus nominal 35m/s approaching travel and 20m margin, capped at 500m. One query and the 64-hull refusal remain.
findings.limits: Faster approaching vehicles, unusually large hulls and engine query cost remain unverified. The prediction horizon alone is not a physical stopping-distance guarantee.

findings.source: Same-direction traffic can set measured-speed caps and short-gap deductions. Predicted rear-end proximity can lower the cap again. The source also excludes its active overtake peer from ordinary following.
findings.wait: Continuous loaded-hull gap/closing allowance remains the WAIT path. Registered convoy predecessor spacing is delegated only when aligned, with close hull contact still vetoed. No new following gains were inferred from this review.

findings.source: Oncoming traffic uses deterministic ID ordering; crossing prediction normally reacts to traffic on the right. FromLeft checks source rank/feature/player status before assuming an approaching left-side peer yields.
findings.wait: Keep current occupied-hull safety and emergency crossing braking for either side. No unacknowledged peer gains permission to cross a conflict merely because a rank or addon marker exists.

findings.source: Forward traffic uses a centre ray and rear traffic uses a fan, bent through curvature helpers. Traffic rays classify a standing vehicle as an obstacle after eight seconds and omit some resulting stop requests; hard occupancy is separately retained by TrafficStep. Empty forward vehicles are delegated to obstacle helpers.
findings.wait: Empty and wrecked hulls remain geometric obstructions. Timer expiration cannot clear occupied space. Bypass admission must prove its own route/ownership and current geometry; this review does not validate the source curvature helpers or whole obstruction chain.
